scopo: Il rimorchio centrale del Big Rig alla scala unica: vano motore e piazzola per l'elicottero. Nessuno a bordo.

stato.nota: Dima approvata dall'utente il 2026-11-21. Le parti specifiche dei prompt sono bozze, da approvare prima di generare. Si genera nella fase G.

specifico.gemini: The model: the middle wagon of that armoured road train: a plain closed armoured box with its corners cut at 45 degrees seen from above, the same at the front and at the back, with side grilles, two tall exhaust stacks, a flat helipad with a painted circle on the roof and a small folded crane arm. A thin tow bar ending in a ring at the front, a hook with a vertical pin at the back. It is a trailer: no cab, no hood, no windscreen, no doors.
specifico.meshy: Low poly game-ready body of an armoured post-apocalyptic trailer wagon, plain closed armoured box with corners cut at 45 degrees, side grilles, two tall exhaust stacks, flat helipad with a painted circle on the roof, small folded crane arm, thin tow bar ending in a ring at the front, hook with a vertical pin at the back. No cab, no windows, no doors. No wheels, empty wheel arches. Neutral light grey armour panels, dark iron frame.

decisioni.testo: Scala unica 1:125: ogni sezione è lunga 5,6 m da gancio a gancio (45 mm, una casella), alta 3,2 m, la più alta del tavolo.

dima._note: Metres, vehicle frame: +x ahead, +y up, +z its right, ground at y = 0, origin under the middle of the length. Boxes between two corners. Starting values: the check (src/models/dima.ts) says whether the figure fits.
